say:1:1621511001:1.text: Where's the "Magic for Babies" book? Did you get it?
say:1:1621511001:1.source_cn: 魔法书呢？那本叫《婴幼儿魔法启蒙》的，你们弄回来了吗？

say:2:1621511002:1.text: Um, w-we did steal it from Meowris, b-but we ran into s-some human students on the way back...
say:2:1621511002:1.source_cn: 呃，从、从从……喵丽丝那边确实偷到了，但、但回来的路上...

say:4:1621511003:1.text: We dropped the book to avoid getting caught, and those students took it back to the library...
say:4:1621511003:1.source_cn: 我们怕暴露，只能丢下书……他们好像把它带回了图书馆。

say:5:1621511004:1.text: What?! That book's all about wicked magic!
say:5:1621511004:1.source_cn: 什么！？那可是一本极其邪恶的魔法书！

say:6:1621511005:1.text: And Meowris is a devil! If she gets her paws on it again, the entire Serene Lyceum will turn into a massive playground for cats!
say:6:1621511005:1.source_cn: 如果落到喵丽丝那个魔王的手里，整个莱希拉姆都得变成猫抓板！

say:9:1621511007:1.text: I bet Meowris has noticed the book is missing and knows we're behind it.
say:9:1621511007:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝肯定已经察觉书丢了，现在一定提高警惕了。

say:10:1621511008:1.text: Since destroying the book's off the table, the only way to upset her apple plans is to confront her directly.
say:10:1621511008:1.source_cn: 既然我们没法销毁那本书，就只能赶在她得逞之前，正面对决...

say:12:1621511009:1.text: W-What?! A-Are you out of your mind? Y-You really think it's a w-wise move?
say:12:1621511009:1.source_cn: 什、什么！？你疯……疯了吧汪达尔！你要跟喵丽丝硬碰硬？

say:13:1621511010:1.text: I heard she once cast magic with just a whisker, turning an entire flock of sparrows into a swirling ball of fluff!
say:13:1621511010:1.source_cn: 听说她只用一根猫胡须就能施法，把整群麻雀卷成个毛球飞走！

say:14:1621511011:1.text: N-No one's ever s-seen her in action, but everyone says her wind magic is deadly... D-Do you want to get yourself killed?
say:14:1621511011:1.source_cn: 谁也没真见过她出手，但大家都说她的风魔法超可怕……你、...

say:15:1621511012:1.text: I'm out, but you do you. I'm not ready to be enslaved by cats!
say:15:1621511012:1.source_cn: 你一个人去吧！我可不想变成猫奴！

say:16:1621511013:1.text: Um, I'm h-heading home to f-finish my meal.
say:16:1621511013:1.source_cn: 阿就、就……我还有饭没吃完，我先走了。

say:18:1621511014:1.text: Most of the dogs take off, leaving only Woofdale behind, eyes full of determination and tail held high.
say:18:1621511014:1.source_cn: 几只狗狗一哄而散，转眼就跑得不见踪影。只剩下汪达尔站在...

say:20:1621511015:1.text: ... Goofie and Pip, you two are such letdowns!

say:21:1621511016:1.text: I'll soldier on, even without anyone backing me up!
say:21:1621511016:1.source_cn: 就算只剩下我一只狗……我也绝不会退缩！<key:dia...
